# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side

data = [
    ("嵇轶伦", "孵化投资部", 52289363),
    ("王应陈", "探究事业部", 24464425),
    ("马雨欣", "财务部", 10003815),
    ("娄玲", "人力资源部", 4315281),
    ("薛羽", "财务部", 3354900),
    ("李玉娟", "财务部", 3100711),
    ("许晶", "人力资源部", 2418041),
    ("闫熹钊", "风控法务部", 2148727),
    ("李蓉", "总裁办", 1645856),
    ("应星星", "行政部", 315772),
    ("陈选雯", "探究事业部", 191904),
    ("朱小凡", "总裁办", 43472),
    ("濮祎妮", "品牌公关部", 0),
]

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "使用周报"

font_name = "微软雅黑"
thin = Side(style="thin", color="BFBFBF")
border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
header_fill = PatternFill("solid", start_color="4472C4")
header_font = Font(name=font_name, bold=True, color="FFFFFF", size=11)
title_font = Font(name=font_name, bold=True, size=14, color="1F3864")
note_font = Font(name=font_name, size=9, color="808080")
body_font = Font(name=font_name, size=11)
center = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
left = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
right = Alignment(horizontal="right", vertical="center")

ws.merge_cells("A1:E1")
ws["A1"] = "EvoMind使用周报（2026年8月第一周）"
ws["A1"].font = title_font
ws["A1"].alignment = center
ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 28

ws.merge_cells("A2:E2")
ws["A2"] = "数据来源：EvoMind管理后端"
ws["A2"].font = note_font
ws["A2"].alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
ws.row_dimensions[2].height = 18

headers = ["排名", "姓名", "部门", "当月累计Token", "较上周使用增长（%）"]
for col, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
    c = ws.cell(row=3, column=col, value=h)
    c.font = header_font
    c.fill = header_fill
    c.alignment = center
    c.border = border
ws.row_dimensions[3].height = 22

r = 4
for i, (name, dept, tokens) in enumerate(data, 1):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=i)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=name)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3, value=dept)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4, value=tokens)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=5, value="N/A")
    for col in range(1, 6):
        c = ws.cell(row=r, column=col)
        c.font = body_font
        c.border = border
        if col == 1:
            c.alignment = center
        elif col in (2, 3):
            c.alignment = left
        elif col == 5:
            c.alignment = center
        else:
            c.alignment = right
            c.number_format = "#,##0"
    if i % 2 == 0:
        for col in range(1, 6):
            ws.cell(row=r, column=col).fill = PatternFill("solid", start_color="EDF2FA")
    r += 1

last = r - 1
ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="合计")
ws.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=1, end_row=r, end_column=3)
ws.cell(row=r, column=4, value=f"=SUM(D4:D{last})")
ws.cell(row=r, column=5, value="N/A")
for col in range(1, 6):
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=col)
    c.font = Font(name=font_name, bold=True, size=11)
    c.border = border
    c.fill = PatternFill("solid", start_color="D9E2F3")
    c.alignment = center if col in (1, 5) else right
    c.number_format = "#,##0" if col == 4 else "General"
ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 22

widths = {"A": 5, "B": 12, "C": 14, "D": 18, "E": 20}
for col, w in widths.items():
    ws.column_dimensions[col].width = w

ws.freeze_panes = "A4"

out = "/workspace/AI 工作区/成果文件/这些图片都是我同事的使用token记录，-conv_3dd6155f18fc/2026-08-09_EvoMind使用周报_2026年8月第一周.xlsx"
wb.save(out)
